My dear [Miss Soulsby](/person/1351),
The worst of it is that I am afraid all the writers of the ‘rejected addresses’ want to be paid and I do not suppose the resources of the [All Saints Magazine](/periodical/254) would warrant that hope.[^1] I am sorry I have sent home most of the competition stories for the Christmas number

yours truly

C M Yonge
I have just found one.

If it will do, write and ask permission of the
[the rest missing]


[^1]: Lucy Soulsby was teaching at Cheltenham Ladies’ College; she seems to have been soliciting contributions for the parish magazine.
